description: A line of four folds round into a ring of four.

walkthrough.line: The ends of your line walk forward and the middles back up, into a ring.
walkthrough.teach: Keep the hands you have. The two dancers on the ends of the line walk forward and the two in the middle back up, and the line folds round into a ring of four with everybody looking at everybody else. You end on the set's own four places, ready for whatever the caller does with the ring.

call.4: BEND THE LINE INTO A RING
